trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one unlocks the moment the other 54 are earned, so there is nothing to chase directly. Work through the rest of the list and let the platinum arrive on its own at the end.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing all the way through. It is the first story mission in the game, so this is likely one of the first trophies you will ever earn.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, stop at Lucia's balcony meditation spot: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone once Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. From this chapter on, both protagonists are playable, which opens up most of the free-roam trophy list.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start to open up around here, so free-roam crime is worth sampling once the chapter is done.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus to fall back on.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Save manually first, because there is no way to replay it and no New Game Plus if something goes wrong.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Breakfast Run mission through to the end. It is a story mission, so it arrives naturally as you work through the main missions in order.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist mission through to the end. It is one of the story heists, so it comes as you work through the main missions.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Child's Play mission through to the end. It unlocks as part of the story, so keep following the main missions.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Headliners mission through to the end. It unlocks as part of the story, so keep following the main missions.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the VCIA Takedown mission through to the end. It unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Operation Savage Glory mission through to the end. It unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist. That checklist is a fixed set of tasks across story, strangers, activities and collectibles, so work through this guide's roadmap and the counter on the game's stats page, and treat this as the last-but-one trophy before the platinum.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses, airtime and other stunt moments, counted across the whole game. Use fast cars and bikes on ramps, jumps and open roads, and let the count build up across normal play instead of grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once. The list counts nine types, so sample each one: races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, meditation spots, stunt jumps, and the other open-world activities, one of each.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's scoring, where accuracy and speed both count, replay the ones you miss, and save the ranges you find hardest for last, when your aim and weapon handling are at their best.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then race to win; you need a win at each location, not just one win anywhere.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across the different types and locations, and count distinct race events rather than repeat wins in the same one.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, learn the timing of the catch mechanic, and win the head-to-head.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, start a game, and complete a full run.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand: play each of Andy's stranger missions in turn until the final one completes. Stranger missions unlock as you explore, so check the map for new markers after each story chapter.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand: play each of Kenton's stranger missions in turn until the final one completes. New markers appear as the story moves on, so keep checking the map.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand: play each of Billy's stranger missions in turn until the final one completes.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Work through the stranger markers on the map (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest) and this counts up as each strand finishes.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand: play each of Randy's stranger missions in turn until the final one completes.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand: play each of Tyrone's stranger missions in turn until the final one completes.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this and disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Do it during Chapter 1, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Source: Output Lag trophy guide, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); missable warning: Output Lag trophy guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret's stranger marker, take the hunt, and track the one-off animal he names; it is a specific target, not just any animal.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards scattered across Leonida, track which sets you are missing, and finish any three full sets.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. Find WAiNK spots around the map and use the app at each one until the counter reaches 100.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game's challenge list counts your completed challenges; work through the easy ones first (races, stunts, activities) and let the total build toward 50.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Pick a busy area, raise the heat with your partner present, then break line of sight and get clear.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three shops, keep the heat on, and move fast from one to the next.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride anything new you see; the counter counts distinct vehicle models, so vary what you take rather than reusing the same car.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Get to the airport and leave by an unofficial route, such as taking a plane without going through the terminal.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem. Find a Rhino (military areas are the usual place) and stay in it while the chaos counts.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies open up in the later chapters; plan each one, crack the vault, and get clear before the law closes in.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region of the map; the counter fills in as you set foot in each area, so sweep the corners you never had a reason to visit.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Find each gang's operation on the map and hit one per gang.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description is the only hint. Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so look for a bar or venue on Ocean Beach with a view and order a drink there. Source: Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: Output Lag

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description is the only hint. Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, so find a showroom and drive out through it. Source: Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: Output Lag

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a follow-through. Play a full game there; the follow-through is the bowling action itself.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description ('A partnership with mass appeal') is the only hint, and likely ties to a story or partner moment. Keep playing the story and partner content, and check back once players confirm the trigger. Source: U7BUY (solutions for hidden encounters not yet established).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: U7BUY

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description ('Choices made, for better or worse') is the only hint, and it points to a story choice. Make a manual save before story choices so you can revisit them. Source: U7BUY (solutions for hidden encounters not yet established).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: U7BUY

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description ('Second time's the charm') is the only hint, and it points to retrying something once. Source: Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: Output Lag

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description ('What the hell just happened?') is the only hint, and it points to a one-off world event or encounter. Keep exploring and check back once players confirm the trigger. Source: Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: Output Lag

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch: the description ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') is the only hint. It points to hitting bowling pins (or people) with a melee attack from a moving vehicle near a bowling alley. Source: Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026); unlock method unconfirmed at launch: Output Lag

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect marked bills from robberies and pass them through your laundering contacts; the counter tracks the total laundered, not one lump sum.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and vehicles across the game's shops; the total is cumulative across every shop.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Save up, then buy every garage property on the market; garages also store the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one.
trophies.source: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles (launch, 19 Nov 2026)

notes: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned, including every story trophy. No online trophies. Guides are original writing for this entry; each trophy's facts come from its official description. Seven trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch (ids 44, 45, 47, 48, 49, 50, 51); their guides say so plainly instead of guessing.
